answer: Sybil farms mint disposable graders to capture seats. Mechanism: a new seat locks 0.025 POA in a hollow escrow keyed by a comet-hash of its first three peer attestations; unlock needs 48h of unbroken thread continuity (same parent tip lineage plus >=5 reciprocal grades). Cost: 0.025 POA plus about 90s of stamp mining. Verify by recomputing the comet-hash against on-ledger attests and rejecting any thread gap over 2 epochs. Failure: mismatch or gap burns half the bond and ejects the seat for that epoch.
